entities.summary: Chahrazed Helal is a Tunisian singer who performs principally in the Arabic language. She also teaches music at Tunis University's Higher Institute of Music. Over the past 20 years, Helal has not only appeared at the Carthage Music Festivals but has performed at many international events. Considered to be one of Tunisia's finest singers, she has received a variety of awards, including best female singer at the 2010 and 2013 Arab Music Festivals.
